exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-12T13:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix lease-

exec card --actor thumbnail-worker lease acquire media-index-writer --ttl 90s
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/original.txt
! stderr .

at 2026-07-12T13:01:30Z
exec card --actor transcript-worker --json lease acquire media-index-writer --ttl 8m
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/takeover.json
! stderr .
exec card --json lease list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/active.jsonl
! stderr .
exec card --json lease show media-index-writer
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/takeover.json
! stderr .

-- golden/original.txt --
media-index-writer	thumbnail-worker	2026-07-12T13:00:00Z	2026-07-12T13:01:30Z
-- golden/takeover.json --
{"name":"media-index-writer","owner":"transcript-worker","acquired_at":"2026-07-12T13:01:30Z","expires_at":"2026-07-12T13:09:30Z"}
-- golden/active.jsonl --
{"name":"media-index-writer","owner":"transcript-worker","acquired_at":"2026-07-12T13:01:30Z","expires_at":"2026-07-12T13:09:30Z"}
